senses.gloss: (cmp. Syr. סוא a. סוח cupio, P. Sm. 2540; 2546, a. זוּחַ I) to be bright, cheer up.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 62b:12">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>דל עינח … ס׳ לבה וכ׳</he> he lifted up her eye (attracted her attention), she saw him, her heart was overjoyed, her spirit fled (she fainted).

senses.gloss: to look up with joy. Ib. 60ᵃ הוה קא מַסְוֵי לאפה (not הות) the child looked up to her with joy (showing that he recognised his mother).
